decisions.reason: As a newly elevated, own-page security service that fits the firm's strategy of integrating GeoIT into broader enterprise systems, it is likely to be retained.

An open GIS development framework is strategically close to the firm's core software and integration business, so despite only being mentioned rather than heavily promoted, it is more likely to stay than be withdrawn.
This identity and access service was still actively presented in 2024 and addresses a clear customer need for integrating GeoIT with existing user management, making continuation very likely.
The workshop builds directly on the firm's consulting and training strengths and, as a low-capital service offer launched in 2024, would usually be kept unless demand disappoints sharply.
